(Japanese: '''ポケモンおはなしげきじょう ピカチュウとあそぼ！''' ''Pokémon Stories Together with Pikachu!'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] published in issues of 幼稚園 and later collected into tankōbon. It is adapted by [[Emiko Yoshino]] and Keiji Kei.
